businesses.business: petroleum refining, fuel logistics and convenience retail

offering_description.value: Par Pacific refines crude oil into transportation and industrial fuels for wholesale buyers, airlines, utilities and motorists. It moves and stores fuels through its pipeline, terminal and marine logistics network. It also sells fuel and convenience merchandise at company-operated stores.

primary_products.value: gasoline; diesel; jet fuel; marine and industrial fuel oil; convenience-store merchandise

primary_services.value: petroleum transportation, terminal handling and storage

customer_segment.value: B2B: wholesale fuel distributors, service-station operators, airlines, marine operators and electric utilities; B2C: motorists and convenience-store shoppers

end_markets.value: road transportation; aviation; marine shipping; electric power generation; convenience retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: wholesale and retail fuel purchases and convenience merchandise; service fees: third-party petroleum transportation, terminal handling and storage

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: refines purchased crude oil into fuels for distributors, airlines, utilities and other commercial buyers; asset operator: operates pipelines and terminals that move and store petroleum for its own operations and third parties; distributor: supplies refined fuels to dealers and commercial customers through regional logistics networks; retailer: sells fuel and sourced convenience merchandise to motorists and shoppers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; distributor; retailer

geography_served.value: US regional: Hawaii, the Pacific Northwest and the Rocky Mountain region, including Washington, Idaho, Montana and Wyoming

specialization.value: related lines: petroleum refining, fuel transportation and storage, wholesale fuel distribution and convenience retail

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bulk fuel supply to airlines, utilities and other commercial accounts; distributors / dealers: wholesale fuel distributors and independently operated service stations; own locations: company-operated fuel stations and convenience stores
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA and state refinery emissions and fuel standards, plus federal pipeline safety rules

notes: The current scope of third-party logistics services is uncertain.
